newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tohoku Oil says refinery operating despite fire.
newsitem.headline: Tohoku Oil says refinery operating despite fire.

text.p: Tohoku Oil Co Ltd said on Monday that a fire had broken out at its 100,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery but the blaze was almost out and the unit was continuing to operate.
A spokeswoman said that there were no reports of casualties from the fire, which broke out earlier on Monday.
"We expect the fire to be put out shortly," the spokeswoman said.
"The refinery is still operating," she added.
The fire broke out at the company's newly installed fuel oil desulphurisation unit, she said.
She did not provide any more details.
The 100,000 bpd refinery is the only one operated by Tohoku Oil, which is part of the Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd group.
